name: r9a class method length ignores defaulted and rest parameters
source:
class C { m(a: number, b: number = 1) {} static s(a: number, b = 2) {} n(a = 1, b = 2) {} r(a: number, ...c: number[]) {} }
function main(): void { const c = new C(); console.log(c.m.length, C.s.length, c.n.length, c.r.length, C.prototype.m.length, new C().m.length); }
